description.value: Over a long rest, using cybertech's implements, you modify your wristpad. It requires attunement, can only be used by you, and serves as a tech focus for your tech powers while attuned. It starts with 4 modification slots, gaining more at higher levels per the engineer class table's Modification Slots column. Each modification beyond your proficiency bonus reduces your tech point maximum by 1. During a long rest you may replace or remove modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), and any effect requiring a save uses your tech save DC.
